features.zh: 恢复深色阅读中的代码、表头和提示框底色。选区跨过行内代码或代码语法标记时，松手后按实际选区连续绘制高亮。
features.en: Restored distinct dark reading surfaces for code, table headings and callouts. Highlights now connect across inline code and syntax tokens after selection settles.

features.zh: 更新关于页的阅读功能与来源介绍，修复深色模式的「支持本站」提示，并缩小手机首页拼图里的「继续阅读」卡片。
features.en: Updated the About page, restored the dark-mode support tooltip, and resized the Continue Reading card in the mobile homepage collage.

features.zh: 拖选含数学符号的笔记时沿用浏览器选区，松手后再绘制连续高亮。分式和上下标交叠处只着色一次。
features.en: Selecting math now uses the browser's selection while dragging, then paints the highlight on release without darkening overlapping fractions or scripts.

features.zh: 校内课程书架去掉网盘域名署名，计算机工程制图补上「大一」标签。
features.en: Removed file-hosting bylines from campus books and added a Year 1 badge to Computer Engineering Drawing.

features.zh: 校内课程的长公式优先在运算符处换行，过宽的矩阵仍可横向滚动。
features.en: Long formulas in campus notes now wrap at operators, with horizontal scrolling still available for wide matrices.

features.zh: 选中公式的一部分时，高亮沿所选符号连成色块，支持单个符号和分式的局部选区。
features.en: Partial formula highlights now follow the selected symbols in continuous bands, including selections within fractions.

content.title: 离散数学 · 五章重审，补上基数、量词和图论的关键证明，整理小节与长式 / Discrete Mathematics · Reviewed five chapters, added proofs for cardinality, quantifiers and graphs, and reorganized sections and long formulas
C++ 程序设计教程 · 修订指针、移位和 OJ 解法，补齐八组作业与练习的目录主题 / C++ Programming · Corrected pointer, shift and online-judge explanations and added topics to eight assignment and practice entries

线性代数与解析几何 · 补上矩阵秩、克拉默法则与正定判别的证明，分行展示行列式计算，补齐作业主题 / Linear Algebra and Analytic Geometry · Added proofs for rank, Cramer’s rule and positive definiteness, split determinant calculations across lines, and filled in homework topics
基础物理 · 去掉重复的原始资料区块，补上平行轴和单缝衍射的推导，统一九份作业的主题写法 / Basic Physics · Removed duplicate source sections, added parallel-axis and single-slit diffraction derivations, and standardized nine homework topics

工科数学分析 · 补上无界数列取子列和单侧极限的证明，分行展示极限与求导，注明作业及测验主题 / Engineering Mathematical Analysis · Added subsequence and one-sided limit proofs, improved the layout of limit and derivative calculations, and added assignment and quiz topics

features.zh: 阅读进度和高亮随账号同步，章节列表显示阅读进度，并支持整条公式高亮。
features.en: Added account-synced reading progress and highlights, chapter progress badges, and whole-formula highlighting.

features.zh: 新增深色模式和页首主题切换按钮，界面默认使用英文，并兼容已有的语言偏好设置。
features.en: Added dark mode and a header theme switch with an English-default interface, including migration from older language preferences.

features.zh: 恢复首页三张书封的慢速揭幕，调整章节悬停效果、滑动阅读控件和火箭加载提示。
features.en: Restored the slower three-cover reveal and refined chapter hover, sliding reading controls, and rocket loading feedback.

features.zh: 将会员投稿移入弹窗，更新资料来源说明，并将阅读进度徽标放在固定位置的章节日期之前。
features.en: Moved member submissions into a compact modal, updated source credits, and placed progress badges before stationary chapter dates.

features.zh: 加大书库首页「继续阅读」与「校内课程」之间的留白。
features.en: Increased the spacing between Continue Reading and Campus Courses in the library.

content.title: 计算机工程制图 · 上线六章笔记，移除课堂练习记录，课程书页保留一个 onsin.top 来源链接 / Computer Engineering Drawing · Published six chapters, removed in-class exercise records, and kept one linked source on the book page

features.zh: 统一线代封面与既有课程的复古学术插画风格，校内课程书壳分别采用酒红、森林绿、赭黄与深靛。新增课程发布检查，防止封面、配色和资料入口退回占位或下载直链。
features.en: Matched the linear algebra illustration to the established vintage academic style, with distinct wine, forest green, ochre and indigo course bindings. Added publication checks for covers, colours and source links.

content.title: 线性代数与解析几何 · 课件及作业来源改为已核验的 Google Drive 只读预览 / Linear Algebra and Analytic Geometry · Verified read-only Google Drive source previews

features.zh: 为离散数学补充专属插画封面及适配手机与桌面的缩略图。
features.en: Added an illustrated cover and responsive thumbnails for Discrete Mathematics.

content.title: 离散数学 · 命题逻辑、谓词逻辑、集合、关系和函数、图论 / Discrete Mathematics · Five chapters of course notes

features.zh: 首页重构为连续滚动的书库导览，更新桌面与手机阅读预览、完整书封和逐行呈现动效；中英文介绍、阅读功能与常见问答同步修订。
features.en: Redesigned the landing page with a continuous library tour, desktop and mobile reading previews, complete book covers, and line-by-line reveals. Revised the introduction, reading features, and FAQ in both languages.

features.zh: 首页导航加粗，小字字号与站内界面统一缩放，首屏标题增加行间留白；语言切换仅文字浮动，按钮背景保持固定。
features.en: Bolder landing navigation, small text that scales with the rest of the site, and more space between hero lines. Language controls now lift only their labels, keeping the button background stationary.

features.zh: 登录提示明确为进入 Lovis 的知识库，移除首页“写在前面”标签；关于介绍和更新日志扩展正文宽度，减少右侧空白。
features.en: Sign-in copy now identifies Lovis’s knowledge vault. Removed the personal-note label and widened the About introduction and release notes to reduce unused space.

features.zh: 新增校内课程大类并置于书库首位；课程书籍以课程目录、作业目录两个按钮切换，时间统一显示大一，作业篇内目录只列题号。
features.en: Added Campus Courses as the first library section. Course books switch between Course contents and Homework contents; dates show the study year, and homework outlines list questions only.

content.title: 工科数学分析 · 课程介绍、23讲课堂笔记与7次作业解析 / Mathematical Analysis · Introduction, 23 lectures and seven homework sets

features.zh: 修正登录后返回原章节、账号恢复和请求失败后的操作反馈，完善留言回复目标失效时的提示。
features.en: Fixed returning to the original chapter after sign-in, account recovery, and feedback after failed requests; clarified unavailable guestbook reply targets.

features.zh: 账号停用时同步撤销待用的密码重置凭据，完善邀请码兼容与碰撞处理；调整管理员审核、账号恢复控件和操作记录的排版。
features.en: Disabling an account now also revokes pending password-reset credentials. Improved invitation-code compatibility and collision handling, plus the layout of administrator reviews, recovery controls, and audit records.

features.zh: 留言板改为头像卡片与独立写留言、回复弹窗；关于简介采用自然段和加粗重点，更新日志新增明确版本号与时间线。账号设置、代码复制、浅色按钮和火箭加载动画继续优化。
features.en: Avatar-based guestbook cards with message and reply dialogs; a flowing About introduction and a versioned release timeline, alongside refined account controls, code copying, lighter buttons and rocket loading states.

features.zh: 书库首页直达分类、搜索和书架；搜索固定显示五项候选，支持列表内滚动，出处以标签展示。
features.en: A compact library entrance with five visible, scrollable search suggestions and framed source labels.

features.zh: 选书新增跟随鼠标的圆环与点击动效；手机导航仅保留投稿图标，书架滚动取消吸附。
features.en: An animated book cursor, an icon-only mobile submission link, and free-scrolling mobile shelves.

features.zh: 收藏移到阅读工具右侧，邮箱支持一键复制；品牌与打赏提示使用统一纸面样式，捎信在展开支付方式后出现。
features.en: Favorites sit beside reading controls; email can be copied; brand and support tooltips use the paper style, and private notes appear after payment options.

features.zh: 书封新增英文标题、更多配色和实体细节；封面下方书名随界面语言切换，手机横滑可浏览全部书籍。
features.en: Refined book materials and colors, English cover titles, localized book names below covers, and complete mobile shelves.

features.zh: 书库内搜索支持候选；投稿独立到顶部导航，表单简化为文字和可选链接。
features.en: Search suggestions in the library; a dedicated submission page with a text field and an optional link.

features.zh: 留言支持回复；注册可选择邀请码或申请；支持支付宝和私密捎信；关于页补充技术架构。
features.en: Guestbook replies, invite-or-application registration, Alipay, private notes and a technical architecture overview.

features.en: Added metadata search, tag filters, updates and private submissions.

features.en: Account settings are available; password changes and permanent deletion await CPU validation and remain disabled.

features.zh: 登录入口与统一发布流程已修正。
features.en: Fixed the sign-in entry and integrated verified releases.

features.en: Added course covers, refined navigation and preface artwork, restored four-book previews on the library home, and made all books available on category pages.

features.en: Added a public landing page and account entry, began previewing account approval and signed-in reading, and refined mobile reading and equation rendering.
